stem: A pipeline at Palisade Studios must apply a configuration with no person present to type a confirmation. Which flag removes the interactive prompt?
rationale: -auto-approve instructs the tool to carry out the plan without asking for confirmation, which is exactly what an unattended pipeline needs. -refresh-only only reconciles state and is a plan mode, not a way to skip a prompt. -target narrows scope to one address but does not remove the confirmation step. -check belongs to formatting and reports formatting status; it has no effect on the confirmation prompt.
